# Labs for this section

No classroom system-design labs are written yet. When they appear they will be step-by-step wiki pages, in the same spirit as the labs on [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}. The exact numbering is still open.

A later lab might walk through a small serving path — a model behind an API, a cache, a queue — without inventing a production platform that is not in this repo.
